hooks.command: p=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$p" in *script.json) node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/validate-script.mjs" "$p" >&2 ;; esac; exit 0
p=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$p" in *.tsx) node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/guard-tokens.mjs" "$p" >&2 ;; esac; exit 0
